stories.title: North Wales Police target illegal off-road biking at Halkyn
stories.summary: North Wales Police have carried out patrols at the Pentre Halkyn protected nature site following reports of off-road vehicles being used there. The patrols were run by the force’s Rural Crime Team and Neighbourhood Policing Officers, working with a Natural Resources Wales officer. stories.title: North Wales Police issue warning over rise in online shopping scams
stories.summary: A warning has been issued to residents across North Wales following a rise in reports of scams surrounding online shopping. stories.title: Headway Flintshire relaunches brain injury support service in Mostyn
stories.summary: A support group for people affected by brain injury in Flintshire has relaunched. Headway Flintshire helps people living with an acquired brain injury, an injury to the brain that happens after birth, along with their families and carers. stories.title: Petition calls on UK Government to reject Connah’s Quay power station plans
stories.summary: A petition is calling on the UK Government to reject plans for a new gas-fired power station with carbon capture at Connah’s Quay.
